content.short: ChangemakersNFT is a place to connect with people who are transforming our world for the good of all.
content.description:
ChangemakersNFT is a platform that brings together people who are passionate about making the world a better place through blockchain technology, especially the Cardano blockchain. It’s a space to learn about blockchain, share updates on blockchain technology, and connect with others who love CNFTs/NFTs and share the same enthusiasm for blockchain.

The idea started with a vision to create a community for blockchain enthusiasts. In February 2024, shokhibulburh4n founded ChangemakersNFT to make this vision a reality. The project stands for fairness and equality, offering a space where everyone is welcome.

In March 2024, the project launched by giving away 100 OG NFTs for free to the first 100 supporters in a fair way. These 100 OG ChangemakersNFTs are listed and verified on Cardano marketplaces like WayUp, JPGStore, JamOnBeard, and others.

Now, ChangemakersNFT is excited to introduce its second collection: ChangemakersArt! ChangemakersArt is part of the ChangemakersNFT project. It allows you to create your own unique ChangemakersArt NFT by transforming other Cardano NFTs you own. If you hold an OG ChangemakersNFT, you’ll get a discount when creating your ChangemakersArt NFT.

ChangemakersArt NFTs are also listed and verified on WayUp, JPGStore, and JamOnBeard.

For more details about ChangemakersNFT, join our Discord server!
